name: DirectBooker
description:
DirectBooker — Book hotels direct for better rates and better service

Plan your trip and book smarter. DirectBooker helps you discover, compare, and book hotels at your destination for all your travel planning needs. The right neighborhood, the right vibe, the amenities you need, and see real-time rates and availability for every property. Unlock member prices and special packages available only when you book direct. And when you book, you book straight with the hotel on their official website, so you get the direct rate and keep everything you've earned: points, elite status and benefits, and exclusive member offers. DirectBooker helps you find great rates for booking independent and boutique hotels, as well as  hotels from all major hotel brands worldwide, including as Best Western, Choice, Hilton, Hyatt, Marriott, Radisson, and more. 

From a last-minute airport room tonight to a resort or villa booked weeks ahead, DirectBooker helps you plan your trip and book smarter.

Direct is best. Better rates, better service, better travel.

Travel planning • hotel search • hotel booking • compare hotel rates • direct hotel deals • trip planning • accommodation • loyalty points & rewards

_published_faq.name: How do I add DirectBooker to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DirectBooker to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.directbooker.ai/claude.

_published_faq.name: Is DirectBooker MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, DirectBooker scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DirectBooker MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DirectBooker provides these MCP tools: hotel-search, hotel-details, hotel-availability-lowest-direct-rate, hotel-lookup-by-name-and-coordinates, hotel-lookup-by-google-place-id, and hotel-photos.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DirectBooker?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DirectBooker in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
DirectBooker does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is DirectBooker failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: DirectBooker scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2).
